scenario: Gateway B acknowledgement failure to Bank X with simultaneous app release v4.2 decoy; synthetic demonstration data.

data.raw_text: Transfer has been hanging since morning, money left my account.
I got debited but the other bank says nothing entered.
My transfer to Bank X is still pending please help.
I tried again and now I don't know if I was charged twice.
Debit alert came but recipient has not seen the money.
This transfer has been processing for too long.
Please check my transfer, balance reduced but no credit.
I used the app and USSD, both are still showing pending.
Transfer failed on screen but the debit is in my account.
The recipient bank has no record of my payment.
I retried the payment and the first debit is still there.
Money left my account at about 10:47 and has not arrived.
Can someone confirm if this transfer went through?

data.claim: Gateway B is not acknowledging successful transfers to Bank X, leaving debit status uncertain.
evidence_for: 92% of affected sampled transactions used Gateway B.
Failure reproduced 5 of 5 times through Gateway B; control route reproduced 0 of 5.
evidence_against: No evidence yet of a wider Gateway B outage.
data.disproof: A synthetic Bank X transfer through Gateway B receives a timely acknowledgement while the same conditions are active.

data.claim: Destination Bank X is rejecting or delaying inbound credits.
evidence_for: Affected transfers share Bank X as destination.
evidence_against: Direct control calls to Bank X succeed.
Failure follows Gateway B rather than destination bank.
data.disproof: Send equivalent synthetic transfers through an alternate healthy gateway; if they succeed, Bank X is not the common failing component.

data.claim: Mobile app release v4.2 introduced an aggressive retry defect that causes the transfer failures.
evidence_for: Release v4.2 occurred during the incident window.
Retry volume increased after the release.
evidence_against: USSD transfers show the same Bank X failure.
Old app version reproduces the same gateway-specific failure.
data.disproof: Run the same synthetic transfer from the old app version; success would support the release hypothesis, while the same failure would disprove it.

data.claim: Core banking posting is delayed and the transfer acknowledgement timeout is only a downstream symptom.
evidence_for: Some customer balances show a debit before the destination confirms credit.
evidence_against: Core posting latency remained within its normal range during the incident window.
data.disproof: Inspect posting and status-update latency during the failing window; normal posting latency while the failure follows Gateway B disproves this hypothesis.

data.test_plan: Run five synthetic Bank X transfers through Gateway B and five equivalent controls through Gateway C; compare acknowledgement outcomes.
Call Bank X directly and through a healthy alternate route, then compare partner responses.
Replay equivalent synthetic transfers on app versions 4.2 and 4.1 while keeping the payment route constant.
Compare core posting and status-update latency with the incident baseline and healthy control window.

steps.title: Contain by rerouting Bank X
steps.description: Route Bank X transfers through Gateway C after approval; monitor the route error rate for ten minutes.

steps.title: Reconcile uncertain transfer states
steps.description: Re-query status for affected transactions and queue unconfirmed items for human reversal review.

steps.title: Prepare permanent connector patch
steps.description: Correct Gateway B acknowledgement timeout and retry handling; submit the diff for engineer review.

data.rollback: Restore Gateway B routing if Gateway C error rate exceeds 2% within ten minutes.
data.verification: Rerun the original failing synthetic tests and confirm live Bank X transfer success returns to baseline.
data.eta_full: 3 hours for connector patch; 4 hours for reconciliation

payload.message: We're sorry. We found an issue affecting your transfer. We are fixing it now and will keep you updated.

data.test_plan: Rerun the original five synthetic Bank X transfers after the approved reroute; all should complete through Gateway C.
